$comment: PRODUCTION Teams package environment (task 043, FR-20, design actions A1/A2; ADR-028 A9 per task 076). Not part of the distributable zip; no build or packaging step reads this file (tests/production-package.test.ts checks env.prod.json). TEAMS_APP_ID is the OWNER-SUPPLIED production Teams app id: CI renders it from the external-spa-prod GitHub environment variable TEAMS_APP_ID into manifest.prod.json (the id placeholder there); the value below is a placeholder, never a real id. The manifest declares no webApplicationInfo and names no client. WORKFORCE_HOME_CLIENT_ID is the production MULTITENANT home client (owner/provisioning supplies; same value as the VITE_WORKFORCE_HOME_MSAL_CLIENT_ID environment variable): the Teams tab signs in with it through NAA at the Teams context tenant. Its SPA redirect URIs, registered by the provisioning operator on the shared multitenant client: https://external.spaarke.com, https://external.spaarke.com/auth-callback.html and brk-multihub://external.spaarke.com. Each customer Teams admin approves the app once (provisioning onboarding gate). AAD_APP_CLIENT_ID is the single-tenant A8 client (same value as VITE_TEAMS_MSAL_CLIENT_ID), used under A9 only for the licensed-user guest-token link; it keeps its SPA redirects brk-multihub://external.spaarke.com (the Teams silent link uses NAA with it) and https://external.spaarke.com/auth-callback.html (the link popup and ssoSilent) - do not prune them. Customer BFF URLs and scopes are NOT here - they are chosen at run time (FR-17).
